title: Main Analysis 3: Cash-Specificity

purpose.statement: Pay off H1a and the Section 2.4 MA3 pooled-interacted design by establishing claim C6: the cash-stock difference in the pre-announcement uncertainty run-up survives a FORMAL Wald test of the cash-minus-stock difference (0.0983**, z~2.07, p=.039, valid at 5%, two-tailed). Critically, SPLIT the EFFECT from the CAUSE: the run-up (EFFECT) is cash-specific and claimable, but the underlying cash build-up (proposed CAUSE) is NOT cash-specific (0.0064 n.s. matched), so the war-chest mechanism stays OPEN. Frame as concentration, not strict specificity; supportive, not definitive.
purpose.reason: 2.2 P3 stated H1a (theta_-1^cash > theta_-1^stock) and 2.4 P3 built the pooled interaction with the formal Wald difference as the anti-Gelman-Stern test; the advisor-corrected ledger confirms C6 is VALID at 5% but fragile (imprecise stock arm) and that its cause leg fails.

proposition_chain.statement: A side-by-side display implies a comparison it never runs, so the pooled interacted model of 2.4 carries both treatments and tests the cash-minus-stock difference directly with a single Wald linear restriction (beta_c - beta_s > 0), which is what estimates theta_-1^cash - theta_-1^stock in H1a; this difference, and not a comparison of one significant coefficient against one insignificant one, is the formal cash-specificity test. The pooled baseline is firms that make neither a cash nor a stock deal.
proposition_chain.reason: The C6 C-trap: the test MUST be the formal Wald linear restriction, never the Gelman-Stern 'significant for cash vs n.s. for stock' side-by-side. Stating this explicitly is mandatory. SEAM-D: the MA3 baseline differs (never-either acquirers).

proposition_chain.statement: On the EFFECT, the pooled model delivers the formal cash-specificity result: the cash arm's pre-announcement uncertainty coefficient is significant (0.0459**) and the stock arm's is insignificant and negative (-0.0524, n.s.), and the formal cash-minus-stock Wald difference is 0.0983** (SE 0.0476; z~2.07, p=.039), significant at the 5% level two-tailed. Because the arms move in opposite directions the gap exceeds either coefficient, roughly a third of a residual standard deviation. This formal linear-restriction test, not a comparison of one significant against one insignificant coefficient, is the cash-specificity claim.
proposition_chain.reason: This IS C6: the EFFECT survives the formal Wald test at 5%. Stating it as the linear restriction explicitly avoids the Gelman-Stern fallacy the ledger flags as referee bait. The empire_cashspec table is two-tailed (note L362), so 'survives a formal test' is accurate, not an overclaim.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C6 (EFFECT_cash 0.0459**; EFFECT_stock -0.0524 n.s.; EFFECT_diff 0.0983** z=2.06 p=.039; 'survives a formal test' ACCURATE)

proposition_chain.statement: On the proposed CAUSE, the cash build-up itself is only weakly cash-sided: the cash-minus-stock difference is insignificant on the matched universe (0.0064, n.s.) and reaches only marginal significance on the full panel (0.0092*). The EFFECT concentrates in cash deals, but the proposed war-chest mechanism is therefore NOT established; the mechanism stays open.
proposition_chain.reason: The EFFECT/CAUSE split is the load-bearing honesty of C6: claim the cash-specific EFFECT, but do NOT claim the cause is cash-specific. This keeps the mechanism-open lock intact and pre-empts a referee who would over-read the run-up as a tested war-chest channel. The CAUSE-matched 0.0064 carries no stars (n.s.) in the table.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C6 (CAUSE_diff_matched 0.0064 n.s.; CAUSE_diff_full 0.0092*; 'the cash build-up itself is NOT cash-specific'; keep mechanism OPEN)

proposition_chain.statement: We therefore read the result as supported but fragile: one formal test at the 5% level supports H1a's claim of concentration in cash, but its significance rides on the imprecise negative stock estimate (-0.0524, SE 0.0436), and the cause's own cash-specificity is weaker still (marginal, full panel only). The wording stays with 'concentrated', not 'specific', the difference between a significant and an insignificant coefficient is explicitly NOT treated as the test, and no cause is asserted.
proposition_chain.reason: Locks C6 at the ledger ceiling: valid-but-fragile, concentration-not-specificity, supportive-not-definitive, mechanism-open. This is the calibrated hedge the body and ledger already carry and must not be dropped.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C6 thinnest_claim + risks ('supportive rather than definitive'; imprecise stock arm -0.0524 n.s. SE 0.0436; mechanism open)

coverage.purpose_fully_delivered: Complete. P1 gives the descriptive cash-vs-stock contrast using the reserved placebo stock column; P2 sets the pooled MA3 design and pre-commits the Wald-not-Gelman-Stern logic plus the never-either baseline; P3 delivers the formal Wald EFFECT result (0.0983**, valid at 5% two-tailed) as a linear restriction; P4 delivers the failing CAUSE leg (mechanism stays open); P5 locks the supported-but-fragile, concentration-not-specificity hedge. C6/H1a delivered exactly at the advisor-corrected ledger ceiling; both C-traps honored (formal Wald, EFFECT/CAUSE split with opposite verdicts).
gaps: The war-chest CAUSE mechanism is deliberately left OPEN (the cause leg fails) -- bounded-by-design, not a missing deliverable
The strength of the formal test rests on a single comparison and an imprecise stock arm -- disclosed as fragility, not hidden

open_decisions: The economic-magnitude SD basis (about a third of a residual SD in P3) is the same open decision surfaced in 3.2; MA3 runs on its own universe (N=25,600 EFFECT), so the SD-scaling is a disclosed approximation. Keep consistent with the 3.2 choice.
